articles.title: A 2-Month Lull Ends With Iran’s Third Strike on US Targets in Bahrain
articles.description: CAIRO (AP) — Iran fired drones across the Persian Gulf on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, its third attack in recent days on American military targets in the tiny island kingdom as Tehran resumed strikes on its Arab neighbors after a roughly two-month lull.
